items.headline: V: United Semiconductors multi-flight orbital semiconductor JV
items.summary: V and United Semiconductors announce a multi-flight joint development agreement to produce semiconductors in orbit for Earth use, citing multiple pending/expected 2026 launches/returns. Potential capacity/revenue catalyst, but terms are undisclosed.

items.headline: O: IPO delayed on AI safety concerns
items.summary: Altman says O will not go public this year, citing safety work still needed. Near-term IPO optionality decreases; longer-term could reflect higher governance/safety spend rather than operational deterioration.

items.headline: G: DOJ probes Nvidia licensing deal
items.summary: Axios reports DOJ is investigating Nvidia’s non-exclusive licensing agreement with G for potential antitrust circumvention. This is a downside legal/regulatory overhang until outcomes are known.

items.headline: O: AI safety board addition
items.summary: O adds an AI safety official (Paul Christiano) to the boards of both O and its nonprofit, with committee safety/security responsibilities. Conservative impact: signals governance focus, not yet measurable financial change.
